meta.title: Sourcewell | AI research assistant that reads first
meta.description: Sourcewell collects sources, checks what they agree on, and writes a sourced report you can hand to a decision maker.

hero.title: Research that starts from sources, not from a guess
hero.subtitle: Sourcewell gathers the documents and pages you point it to, compares what they say, and writes a report with every claim linked to its source.
hero.proof: Sample research report with demo sources
hero.mockCaption: Demo data. Sources shown are samples.

problem.title: Good research takes days. Decisions take hours
problem.text: Reports need sources, and sources need reading. Teams skim a few pages, miss the disagreement, and write a recommendation on a thin base.

benefits.title: A report you can defend, in hours
benefits.subtitle: Four things Sourcewell does for a research task.

items.title: Collects the sources for you
items.text: Drop in links, PDFs, and notes. Sourcewell reads each one and keeps the list organised by topic.

items.title: Shows where sources disagree
items.text: Claims that conflict are flagged side by side, with the exact passage each one rests on.

items.title: Writes a sourced report
items.text: Every claim in the report links back to its source, so a reader can check the basis of any sentence.

items.title: Keeps your material private
items.text: Your documents stay in your workspace. They are used only for your report and never shared.

tagline: Read less. Know more. Every claim in the report points to the page it came from.

steps.title: How Sourcewell works
steps.subtitle: Three steps from question to report.

items.title: Ask the question
items.text: Write the research question and add the sources you already have, or let Sourcewell suggest more.

items.title: Review the evidence
items.text: Sourcewell extracts the claims, groups them by topic, and flags where sources disagree.

items.title: Get the report
items.text: A structured report arrives with citations, a summary, and the open questions that need a human call.

items.quote: I used to spend a day reading before I could write a page. Now the evidence table is ready in the morning and I spend the day on the judgement.
items.name: Hana El Sherif

items.quote: The disagreement flags saved us from a bad recommendation. Two sources we trusted said opposite things, and the report showed it plainly.
items.name: Adam Nabil

items.q: Where do the sources come from?
items.a: From the links and documents you add, plus sources Sourcewell suggests from public material. Every source is listed in the report.
Each claim links to the exact passage it rests on, so you can open the source and check it before you rely on the report.
The report flags the disagreement, shows both sides, and leaves the call to you. It never hides a conflicting source.
Yes. Upload PDFs, documents, and web pages. Scanned pages need readable text to be analysed.
